[[Meetra Surik]] wielded a personal [[Color/Legends|blue]]-bladed<ref name="Revan" /> '''lightsaber''' during<ref name="KotOR II" /> and after<ref name="Revan" /> the [[Dark Wars]]. The tool was constructed by Surik under the [[Teacher/Legends|tutelage]] of [[Kreia]]. The blade was the exile's second [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Meetra Surik's first lightsaber|first lightsaber]] having been confiscated by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] and kept by [[Atris]] at the [[Telosian Jedi Academy]] after Surik was exiled. Surik carried her new lightsaber as she searched for the [[Lost Jedi]] and defeated the [[Sith Triumvirate]] before setting off to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] in search of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|True Sith]].<ref name="KotOR II" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', the color of the lightsaber blade depends on player customization. ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' later established the color to be blue.
